newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait Ahmadi refinery maintenance completed.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait Ahmadi refinery maintenance completed.

text.p: Kuwait National Petroleum Co has completed maintenance work on a crude distillation unit (CDU) at Mina al-Ahmadi refinery, industry sources said on Sunday.
The CDU "is up and running," said one source. The two-week maintenance was completed on Friday and the unit came back on stream on Saturday.
Kuwait plans major maintenance work at the 420,000 barrel per day (bpd) Ahmadi refinery in March and April 1997, industry sources earlier told Reuters.
Ahmadi, which operates under state refiner KNPC, is a major exporter of middle distillates such as gas oil (diesel) and kerosene to Asia and the Indian subcontinent.
OPEC member Kuwait has a production quota of two million bpd and a local refining capacity of 830,000 bpd.
